planets.name: HAT-P-70 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-70 with a 2.74-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: HAT-P-70 b was found in 2019 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-70. Its orbit and size follow Zhou et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
